name: PayNow

status.webhook_verification: SHA512 hash of concatenated field values + integration key, uppercase hex; verify on every callback/poll response

credentials_required.label: Integration Key
credentials_required.note: same screen; used to compute/verify the SHA512 hash

credentials_required.label: Merchant email
credentials_required.note: email registered on the integration; used as authemail in TEST mode

test_credentials.note: PayNow issues test integrations; ManishaPay also offers a shared simulated sandbox needing zero credentials

sandbox.notes: Express/mobile-money test numbers (0771111111 etc.) simulate outcomes. TEST integrations reject any authemail that isn't the registered merchant email.

pain_points.cause: C# SDK sends '2.00' / locale-comma decimals PayNow rejects
pain_points.mitigation: Normalize amount to a strict 0.00 invariant string before sending

pain_points.problem: Express checkout silently skips the OTP prompt
pain_points.mitigation: Normalize phone to 263 form before forwarding

pain_points.cause: Wrong field order / integration key when computing the SHA512 hash
pain_points.mitigation: Compute hash over fields in the exact documented order; expose a hash-debug tool for expected-vs-actual diff

pain_points.problem: 'Merchant still in test' rejections on live
pain_points.mitigation: Detect the message and tell the merchant to Go Live in PayNow, then add a live credential

pain_points.problem: TEST mode rejects the customer email
pain_points.cause: TEST integrations require authemail = the registered merchant email
pain_points.mitigation: Store the merchant email per credential and swap it in automatically in test mode

notes: Zimbabwe's dominant aggregator — one PayNow integration unlocks EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Omari, ZimSwitch and card. Money flows directly to the merchant's PayNow wallet; ManishaPay never holds funds.
